summary.en: The photo that won. Everything after is "the other drummer," even if that drummer tours for twenty years.
summary.zh: 那张赢了的合影。之后所有人，哪怕巡演二十年，都是「另一位鼓手」。

body.en:
Fans don't remember chronology; they remember a poster. Four faces locked to one album cycle—Zeppelin around IV, Beatles somewhere between wit and the end of the world—and suddenly that cast is the real band. Later humans become footnotes with drumsticks.

It's unfair and completely understandable. Peak chemistry has a smell. Record companies freeze it into merch. We treat classic lineups as named seasons with years attached, so you can love the myth without pretending the other seasons never aired.
body.zh:
粉丝记不住年表；他们记得一张海报。四张脸锁死在一轮专辑上——Zeppelin 的 IV 前后，Beatles 在机智与世界末日之间——然后这卡司就成了「真乐队」。后来的人变成带鼓棒的脚注。

不公平，但完全能懂。巅峰化学反应有气味。厂牌把它冻进周边。我们把经典阵容当成带年份的季数：你可以爱神话，也不用假装其它季没播过。

note.en: The arc everyone argues about dating.
note.zh: 人人都在争论该从哪张盘算起的那条弧。
